crop.notes: Clipping is the top of Wray's Column; only the 'Long Time Between Fights' item is about Allen, and it is complete.

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch's Wray's Column recalled that the last heavyweight title fight near St. Louis was Allen's 1873 seven-round win over Mike McCoole on a Mississippi island above the city.

metadata.notes: St. Louis Post-Dispatch, Sunday Morning, July 12, 1931, page 2E.

facts.fact: Allen, about 170 pounds, beat McCoole in a bare-knuckle seven-round fight in 1873 on a Mississippi island above St. Louis, regaining the crown McCoole had taken from him four years earlier under questionable circumstances
places: island in the Mississippi above St. Louis (now part of East St. Louis)

facts.fact: Allen lost his crown to Joe Goss in a fight near Louisville, Ky.

notes: Year of the Goss fight is not given in the item (1876 from other records).
